check.text: RECORD COMPLETE: 35 CHOICES, 7 FIGHTS REPLAYED AND MATCHED

event.name: A Deserter
event.text: An officer, by the look of the blade at their hip, bleeding from a wound they won't explain.

options.label: TAKE THEM IN
options.text: They join you at a third of their HP, knowing two abilities, with a rare piece suited to them.

options.label: A LESSON
options.text: They teach yours an officer's drill and walk on: three members each learn an ability or train one.

options.label: TAKE THE BLADE
options.text: A rare piece; they limp off.

event.name: The Master Smith
event.text: The smith is drunk, cheerful and working for free. "Give it here. I'll make it sing."

options.label: LET HIM TRY
options.text: A piece of yours becomes one of the next rarity, of its kind (a rare one a legendary). Half the time it cracks and is lost.

notes: The Master Smith: let him try.
Tempered: Cairn blade into Sigil blade.

notes.text: Act 1: The Old Road. The Chief's Return waits at the end.
